mica (arch): quick sync — alias flips during the canary sweep caused a ton of cold starts in staging. want to propose metadata-driven soft-evict behavior to reduce blast radius.
oz (infra): what's the exact sequence? control-plane writes, resolver churn, or runtime eviction?
hema (runtime): mainly control-plane alias updates. current flow: publish alias -> runtime immediately unbinds cached variant -> lots of KV rebuilds. latency SLOs were hit.
gio (product): customers noticed errors during the rollout. need a safer canary story.
hema (runtime): proposal: add rollout metadata to control-plane alias writes: stability_window_ms, evict_grace_ms, alias_mode (hard|soft|sticky), client_probe_hint, expected_dual_serve. runtime would defer hard eviction and mark previous binding as stale for evict_grace_ms.
mica (arch): example metadata blob (informal):
```
rollout_id: rl-20260323-314
stability_window_ms: 600000
evict_grace_ms: 180000
alias_mode: soft
client_probe_hint: prefer-stable-variant
expected_dual_serve: true
```
lucy (sre): we need metrics: alias_transition_count, deferred_eviction_seconds, dual_serve_observed, pin_override_count. alert if deferred_eviction > threshold AND error rate rises.
oz (infra): backwards compat: unknown fields must be ignored. default alias_mode=hard so older runtimes keep current behavior. gate soft-mode behind cluster feature-flag.
hema (runtime): runtime plan: maintain lease state per alias: ACTIVE, PENDING_DEFERRED_EVICT, STALE. on flip, mark previous as PENDING_DEFERRED_EVICT and background-reconcile to HARD_EVICT after evict_grace_ms and low traffic. tenant explicit pins always override metadata.
gio (product): UX: during grace window there may be dual-serving. surface expected_dual_serve in console and docs. default false for immediate switches, true for staged rollouts.
mica (arch): add tenant_eviction_opt_out boolean for enterprise tenants (requires auth & audit trail).
lucy (sre): infra-bot create ticket for metrics + alerting please.
infra-bot: created MET-2026-431: "alias stability metrics & deferred eviction alerting" assigned to lucy.
oz (infra): i'll add feature-flag config and a migration playbook: enable in staging clusters, smoke test, then canaries.
hema (runtime): test plan: simulate flip storm (50 flips / 5m) and assert cold-start rate <= 1.5x baseline. add unit tests for lease transitions.
mica (arch): decision: prototype soft alias_mode + stability_window in staging behind FF. owners: hema(runtime), oz(infra), gio(product), lucy(sre). follow-up: RFC draft for alias lifecycle and console copy.
